text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; please tell me how many hours old you were when the trouble started and if you were born prematurely. REQUEST TEST: Arterial_Blood_Gas.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: pH: 7.30 (slightly acidic), PaCO2: 50 mmHg (elevated), PaO2: 60 mmHg (reduced), HCO3-: 24 mEq/L

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS). The arterial blood gas showing respiratory acidosis (elevated PaCO2, low pH) with reduced oxygenation is consistent with surfactant deficiency and alveolar collapse. Please confirm gestational age and provide a Chest_X-Ray to visualize ground-glass opacities typical of RDS.
